title: Project Management Coordinator
description:
About the role
 The Project Management Coordinator role is essential for maintaining the structure and rhythm of our high level advisory work. In this position, you will support our principals as we assist a major regional logistics and transportation group through a complex transition of their operating model. You will provide the organizational support needed to ensure that our strategic recommendations are tracked, documented, and moved toward a final decision.

About Arabian Private Holdings
 Arabian Private Holdings was founded on the principle that many critical business problems do not fit the traditional large firm consulting model. A board facing a succession question or a family group weighing a capital injection does not need a team of twelve associates and a hundred page methodology deck. They need experienced partners who can sit with a problem, form a rigorous view, and defend it. We take on a limited number of mandates to ensure that every client receives direct attention from the principals who are actually accountable for the outcome. Our work covers corporate strategy, governance, and operating model efficiency for significant family groups and government entities. We operate as a remote firm, choosing to prioritize the quality of our analysis over traditional office overhead.

What you will do
  • Coordinate project timelines and schedules to ensure that all mandate milestones are met on time.
  • Support our principals in gathering research and data related to the logistics sector to help form a clear view on client challenges.
  • Draft concise internal updates and reports regarding the progress of specific portfolio projects.
  • Organize and maintain project documentation to ensure all data is accurate and accessible to the team.
  • Monitor project risks or delays and communicate them clearly to the responsible partners.
  • Assist in the preparation of governance documents and strategy materials for board level presentations.
  • Track communication between our firm and client representatives to maintain a clear record of decisions made.
  • Support the refinement of client operating models by documenting current processes and proposed changes.


What we are looking for
  • A logical mindset and the ability to organize complex information into clear, actionable steps.
  • Strong writing skills with a focus on precision and the ability to communicate ideas without using corporate jargon.
  • A high level of attention to detail when reviewing documents and project schedules.
  • Curiosity about how large holding companies and regional logistics firms function at a governance level.
  • The ability to work independently and manage your own tasks effectively in a remote setting.
  • Basic familiarity with digital tools for project tracking or a strong willingness to learn our specific methods.


How we work
 We operate as a fully remote firm, which allows us to focus on the clarity of our thinking rather than the logistics of an office. This model requires a high degree of professional maturity and trust. title: Product Manager
description:
Location: Remote / Hybrid (UK)

Job Type: Full-time

Salary: Â£65k - Â£80k, dependent on experience

Shape the Future of Service Management


For more than 36 years, Marval has been at the forefront of Service Management innovation. As one of the original co-authors of ITIL, we've helped define the standards that organisations across the globe still rely on today. Now, we're building on that legacy.


Our intelligent, no-code ITSM, ESM and Managed Service Management solutions empower organisations worldwide to transform the way they deliver services. As we continue to evolve our platform and accelerate our product strategy, we're looking for an ambitious Product Manager who wants to make a real impact.

If you thrive in flexible, fast-paced environments, enjoy solving complex customer problems and want genuine ownership of product decisions, we'd love to hear from you.

The Opportunity


As a Product Manager at Marval, you'll own a key area of our product roadmap from discovery through to delivery, launch and continuous improvement. This isn't a role where you'll simply manage a backlog or write requirements. We're looking for someone who loves talking to customers, validating ideas, challenging assumptions and working side-by-side with Development, Customer Success and Sales to build products that solve real problems. You'll have the autonomy to make decisions, influence product strategy and help shape the future of our platform.


What You'll Be Doing


  • Own the full product lifecycle, from customer discovery through to launch and ongoing optimisation.
  • Work closely with customers and internal stakeholders to identify genuine business problems and opportunities.
  • Prioritise features based on customer value, business goals and technical considerations.
  • Create clear product specifications and user stories that enable successful delivery.
  • Collaborate with Development throughout the development lifecycle, making informed trade-off decisions where required.
  • Analyse product performance, customer feedback and usage data to continually improve the user experience.
  • Communicate roadmap priorities, progress and strategic direction across the business.
  • Help develop and improve Product Management processes, tooling and ways of working as we continue to scale.


Skills and Experience


We're more interested in how you think, solve problems and collaborate with others.


You'll ideally have:


  • At least four years' experience in Product Management within B2B SaaS, Enterprise Software or a similar technology environment.
  • A strong understanding of IT Service Management (ITSM), Enterprise Service Management (ESM) or Service Management solutions.
  • Experience delivering successful software features that have improved customer adoption, engagement, retention or revenue.
  • Experience working within Agile product development teams.
  • Strong communication skills with the confidence to influence technical and non-technical stakeholders alike.
  • A customer-first mindset with excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities.
We'd love it if you also have:


  • Experience with no-code or low-code platforms.
  • Experience working in a startup or scale-up environment or have that mindset.
  • Exposure to global customer markets.
  • A passion for modern product management and continuous improvement.


Why Join Marval?


This is an opportunity to join a business with a proud heritage while helping shape its future.


At Marval, you'll enjoy:


  • Real ownership of product decisions and roadmap priorities.
  • The opportunity to influence products used by organisations around the world.
  • Flexible remote and hybrid working.
  • A collaborative, supportive team that values innovation and fresh thinking.
  • The stability of an established software company combined with the pace and ambition of a growing technology business.
  • Ongoing opportunities for professional development and career progression.
About You


You're someone who:


  • Is comfortable making decisions without having every piece of information.
  • Enjoys asking "why?" and digging beneath customer requests to uncover the real problem.
  • Works well with ambiguity and enjoys creating clarity where none exists.
  • Values collaboration and constructive challenge.
  • Takes ownership, learns quickly and isn't afraid to adapt when priorities change.
  • Wants to build products that customers genuinely love using.

title: Video Editor Reacts
description:
About Us

Beast Industries is a multifaceted media and entertainment company founded by Jimmy Donaldson, popularly known as MrBeast, the most watched person in the world. Renowned for revolutionizing digital content creation, Beast Industries encompasses a diverse portfolio of ventures that extend far beyond its origins on YouTube. With a mission to entertain, inspire, and create significant social impact, Beast Industries operates across various domains including digital media, philanthropy, consumer products, and innovative business initiatives. At Beast Industries, we believe in the transformative power of digital media and its potential to entertain, educate, and effect positive change. Our commitment to innovation, creativity, and philanthropy drives us to explore new frontiers, create unforgettable experiences, and build a legacy that inspires future generations.

About the Role

MrBeast is looking for a data-driven, creative, and fast-paced Video Editor to join our Content & Post-Production team working on the MrBeast Reacts channel. This role is for a master-level editor who lives and breathes YouTube culture, capable of transforming raw multi-cam reaction feeds into hyper-engaging content that keeps millions of viewers locked in. You will thrive in a high-feedback environment, balancing aggressive production schedules with a relentless obsession for frame-by-frame pacing and audience retention.

What You'll Do
  • Cut and assemble raw multi-cam reaction footage, seamlessly balancing primary talent commentary, PIP source media, and visual punch-ins.
  • Engineer high-retention video intros and hooks that immediately fulfill title and thumbnail promises within the first 30 seconds.
  • Execute hyper-fast pacing, comedic timing, and visual pop-ups, including kinetic typography, memes, and custom tracking graphics.
  • Perform high-quality sound design, including impactful SFX, dynamic music ducking, and precise audio balancing for voice clarity.
  • Collaborate closely with Lead Editors and creative teams to incorporate rapid turnaround notes and feedback loops.
  • Analyze YouTube retention curves alongside lead editors to pinpoint drop-off moments and refine pacing rules for subsequent edits.
  • Maintain clean, highly organized timeline projects in Adobe Premiere Pro and After Effects, adhering to internal post-production standards.
  • Coordinate with the thumbnail team to ensure visual assets and key video climaxes align perfectly with channel creative strategy.
  • Stay ahead of internet culture and viral editing meta to continuously inject fresh humor and visual variety into channel content.
What We're Looking For
  • 3+ years of professional video editing experience focused on high-pacing YouTube, commentary, or viral digital content.
  • Expert-level proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro and Adobe After Effects, specifically with keyframing, motion tracking, masking, and dynamic linking.
  • Deep structural understanding of YouTube algorithm dynamics, Average View Duration (AVD), CTR, and retention curve analysis.
  • Mastery of dynamic sound design, audio leveling, and music curation to enhance comedic and emotional shifts.
  • A data-driven mindset that prioritizes viewer retention evidence over personal creative assumptions.
  • High feedback sensitivity, with the ability to handle rapid creative criticism constructively and pivot quickly.
  • Exceptional attention to detail, maintaining frame-by-frame precision in pacing and visual overlays.
  • Proven ability to manage high-volume workflows, including file compression, color correction, and final exports optimized for YouTube.
  • Extreme ownership over end-to-end video performance, production deadlines, and technical accuracy.
BenefitsThe Perks, Why Work On the MrBeast Team

We are redefining what entertainment and storytelling look like at global scale. Every piece of content we publish reaches millions and influences culture in real time. This is your opportunity to lead the team that decides how those moments come to life across every screen.

title: (Senior) Manager Network Planning Train - Bau- & Jahresplanung (m/w/d)
description:
Bei FlixTrain gestaltest du die Zukunft der Mobilität aktiv mit. Wir bieten dir nicht nur sichere Arbeitsplätze sowie attraktive Zusatzleistungen, sondern auch ein dynamisches, internationales Umfeld, in dem deine Ideen echten Einfluss haben. 

 

Als Teil unseres schnell wachsenden Travel-Tech-Unternehmens arbeitest du an der Schnittstelle von Infrastruktur, Betrieb und kommerzieller Planung und sorgst dafür, dass unser Netzwerk auch während umfangreicher Bauphasen attraktiv, zuverlässig und wirtschaftlich erfolgreich bleibt.

 

Über die Rolle

 

  • Du unterstützt die Entwicklung und Optimierung des jährlichen Fahrplankonzepts und berücksichtigst dabei die Auswirkungen geplanter Infrastrukturmaßnahmen
  • Die Auswirkungen von Bauprojekten auf das FlixTrain-Netzwerk analysierst du und leitest daraus fundierte Handlungsempfehlungen sowie alternative Konzepte ab
  • Datengetriebene Analysen mit Excel, BI-Tools und ersten KI-Anwendungen helfen dir dabei, kommerzielle Auswirkungen auf Nachfrage, Umsatz und Kosten zu bewerten
  • Gemeinsam mit den Teams aus Commercial Planning, Operations und Betriebsplanung entwickelst du umsetzbare Lösungen für baubedingte Herausforderungen
  • Externe Stakeholder-Termine mit DB InfraGO, der Bundesnetzagentur und weiteren Partnern bereitest du vor und vertrittst dabei die Interessen von FlixTrain

Über dich 

 

  • Du verfügst über gute Kenntnisse der Verkehrsgeographie in Deutschland und interessierst dich für die Zusammenhänge zwischen Infrastruktur, Betrieb und Wirtschaftlichkeit
  • Analytisches Denken, ein ausgeprägtes Zahlenverständnis sowie sehr gute Excel-Kenntnisse zeichnen dich aus
  • Erste Berufserfahrung im Bereich Network Planning (Netzplanung), Kapazitätsmanagement, Transport, Infrastruktur, Consulting oder einem vergleichbaren Umfeld bringst du bereits mit
  • Eine strukturierte, eigenständige und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise kombinierst du mit starken Kommunikationsfähigkeiten und Freude an bereichsübergreifender Zusammenarbeit
  • Fließende Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse (C1-Niveau) sind für dich selbstverständlich
  • Erfahrungen mit KOMBau, FBS, IVU, SQL, Python, BI-Tools oder KI-Anwendungen sind ein Plus aber kein muss

Bei uns zählt der Blick auf das Ganze - auch wenn du nicht alle Anforderungen zu 100 % erfüllst, aber dennoch glaubst, etwas bewegen zu können, freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung! 

Was Wir Bieten

 

  • Reisevorteile: 12 kostenlose Flix-Gutscheine + 12 Rabattgutscheine für Freunde & Familie.
  • Arbeiten von Überall: Je nach Rolle kannst du bis zu 60 Tage pro Jahr von einem anderen Standort aus arbeiten.
  • Hybrides Arbeitsmodell: Wir sind ein Unternehmen mit Bürokultur, bieten jedoch Flexibilität, um Arbeit und Leben in Einklang zu bringen.
  • Gesundheits- und Wohlfühlangebote: Zugang zu vertraulichen Einzelberatungen, Kursen und Stressbewältigungsmaßnahmen – für dich und bis zu vier Familienangehörige.
  • Lernen & Entwicklung: Nutze Sprachkurse, Schulungen und Experten-Sessions, um deine Fähigkeiten auszubauen.
  • Mentoring-Programm: Vernetze dich mit erfahrenen Kollegen, um Einblicke zu gewinnen und deine Karriere zu beschleunigen.

 

Warum Teil von Flix werden? 

Bei Flix konzentrieren wir uns darauf, Reisen einfach, sicher und erschwinglich zu gestalten – sowohl für unsere Passagiere als auch für unsere Mitarbeiter. Hier geht es schnell voran, und es gibt viel Raum, etwas zu bewegen. Wir wachsen und entwickeln uns täglich weiter und suchen Menschen, die bereit sind, sich einzubringen und die Art und Weise, wie wir arbeiten, mitzugestalten. Wenn du einen Job suchst, in dem du wachsen und etwas bewirken kannst, dann bist du bei FlixTrain genau richtig. Hier kannst du Teil eines Teams werden, in dem dein Beitrag zählt und du deine Reise selbst gestalten kannst!

title: JavaScript-Entwickler (m/w/d)
description:
Wir betreuen ein JavaScript-Tool, das aus modellierten Geschäftsprozessen automatisch Auswertungen erzeugt — zum Beispiel, wie viel Arbeitszeit ein Prozess kostet und wie viele Mitarbeiter dafür nötig sind.

Das Tool ist über Jahre gewachsen und wird laufend erweitert. Dafür suchen wir Verstärkung.

Aufgaben

  • Neue Funktionen in JavaScript umsetzen
  • Fehler suchen und beheben
  • Berechnungslogik anpassen, wenn sich fachliche Vorgaben ändern
  • Auswertungen erweitern und verbessern
  • Abstimmung mit dem Fachbereich
  • Ergebnisse regelmäßig dem Kunden vorstellen — remote per MS Teams

Qualifikation

  • Gute JavaScript-Kenntnisse
  • Spaß daran, dich in bestehenden Code einzuarbeiten
  • Sorgfältige Arbeitsweise — die Ergebnisse fließen in echte Personalplanung ein
  • Sicheres Auftreten in Kundenterminen — du kannst deine Ergebnisse remote per Teams verständlich präsentieren, auch gegenüber Nicht-Technikern
  • Deutsch mind. C1 in Wort und Schrift (das Projekt läuft komplett auf Deutsch)

Schön, aber kein Muss

  • Erfahrung mit älterem JavaScript (ohne Frameworks)
  • Erfahrung mit der ARIS REST API
  • Kenntnisse in Geschäftsprozessmodellierung

Benefits

  • Remote-First-Arbeitsweise – arbeite dort, wo du am produktivsten bist (Homeoffice oder Co-Working)
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten – Ergebnisse zählen, nicht die Uhr
  • Abwechslungsreiche Projekte – mit modernen Technologien und spannenden Kunden
  • Modernes Equipment – leistungsstark und auf deine Bedürfnisse abgestimmt

description:
You must be located in Europe to be considered for this position and are available for occasional travel to our Munich, Germany office.

Tulip brings modern technology and AI into manufacturing. Manufacturing accounts for almost 20% of the global economy and one in every seven workers on Earth, yet remains among the least digitized. More than a decade ago, we created the category to close that gap: AI-native software that puts cutting-edge tools directly in the hands of the people on the manufacturing front lines. Because we are human-centered and tech-obsessed, we are building a future of work where human ingenuity is amplified with the latest technology.

In January 2026 we became one of Boston's few new AI unicorns, reaching a $1.3B valuation. We're growing double digits in revenue year over year. The world's best manufacturers run on Tulip - turning inventory 10x faster, releasing gene therapies in hours instead of weeks, and training master craftspeople to forge engagement rings 5x more rapidly. Headquartered in Somerville, MA with offices in Germany, Hungary, Singapore, Japan, and Israel, we've been consistently named a World Economic Forum Global Innovator, a Gartner leader, and one of Built In Boston's "Best Places to Work."

We run the way we build: AI-forward, humanistic, and high ownership. We're looking for builders who are energized by complex problems, rapid cycles, and the unique opportunity to see their impact on a global scale.

About the Role:

Tulip is expanding fast across international markets, and this role sits at the center of that growth. You build demand in regions where we are still establishing the brand, with real room to shape how Tulip shows up and wins. This is full ownership of the marketing plan for your region, not a slice of the funnel.

You own or co-manage one or more regions: the account programs, the field events, and the pipeline that comes from them. You are the lynchpin between your region and the commercial organization, working alongside sales, BDRs, and partners to build go-to-market motions that convert target accounts. You continuously iterate on which programs and accounts work, optimize spend across your region, and own the plan from strategy to execution without waiting on a hand-off. You have a high ceiling, are full of ideas, analytically rigorous, and wired to see your work drive real outcomes. You are motivated to both sell and build with AI, and here you use it to produce, test, and iterate faster than a traditional team can.

What skills do I need?

  • 8-10+ years of experience in go-to-market, regional marketing, or partner marketing, with a record of owning outcomes rather than completing tasks.
  • Experience running account- and journey-based programs against a defined target account list, from campaign build to pipeline attribution.
  • Track record collaborating with BDRs, AEs, and partners on target accounts through structured programs: joint account planning, account prioritization, and coordinated outreach against a shared pipeline target.
  • Regional market fluency: adapting messaging and programs to local buying behavior, language, and market norms.
  • Analytical rigor: you understand pipeline math, read a campaign performance report, and tell signal from noise.
  • Low ego, high accountability: you would rather learn what works than be right.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Own and carry pipeline targets for one or more regions.
  • Build and own the regional marketing plan and account segmentation across core and ABM channels.
  • Understand regional industries and target personas, then define content needs and formats and drive production and localization.
  • Build and run account-based programs against target accounts, coordinating campaigns and outreach with BDRs and AEs.
  • Run or support conferences and regional field events from planning through pipeline attribution.
  • Use AI to produce, test, and iterate on assets and campaigns at higher volume.

Key Collaborators:

  • Regional Sales leadership
  • BDRs and Account Executives
  • RevOps
  • Digital Marketing
  • AI go-to-market engineer
  • Product Marketing

Working At Tulip

We know even great candidates experience imposter syndrome. Even if you don't match every requirement, applying gives you the opportunity to be considered. We're building a strong, diverse team that values hard work, families, and personal well-being. Benefits of working with us include:

  • Direct impact on product and culture
  • Company equity
  • Competitive benefits package including commuter benefits, learning and development stipend, team events, catered lunches 3 days a week
  • Flexible work schedule and unlimited vacation policy
  • An inclusive, dog-friendly office with diverse and inspiring colleagues

We are an equal opportunity employer. At Tulip, we celebrate all. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. Help us build an inclusive community that will transform frontline operations.

Wir suchen keine Person, die schöne Mockups baut und dann abwartet.

DrAnsay macht Gesundheitsversorgung zugänglicher. Wir haben 2018 mit dem ersten digitalen Gesundheitsservice angefangen und investieren in z.B. medizinisches Cannabis, Abnehmspritze und Men's Health.

Clarity Creates Speed, wir kommunizieren klar, dokumentieren Entscheidungen und schaffen Transparenz. Build What Matters, wir fokussieren uns auf echten Impact, nicht auf Perfektion. 

Kleines Team, kurze Wege, echte Eigenverantwortung. Kein Investment-Board. Kein Design-by-Committee. 

 

Die Rolle 

Du arbeitest direkt im Product-/Design-Team und verantwortest die UI-Execution unserer Mobile App. Keine Endlos-Workshops. Keine Konzept-Spiralen. Du bringst visuelle Qualität auf den Screen, plattformgerecht, entwicklerfreundlich, konsistent.

Das bieten wir

title: Werkstudent:in PR & Externe Kommunikation (all genders)
description:

Mit unseren Foodjis bringen wir ultrafrische, leckere Gerichte genau dorthin wo du die meiste Zeit verbringst - denn wir haben uns zum Ziel gesetzt über 10 Millionen Arbeitnehmern endlich Zugang zu gesunder Ernährung zu ermöglichen und gleichzeitig Foodwaste zu reduzieren.

Du suchst einen PR-Job in einem Startup mit echtem Impact und viel Verantwortung ab Tag eins?

Als Werkstudent:in PR & Externe Kommunikation übernimmst du die komplette PR-Arbeit inhouse – von der Themenplanung über Journalist:innenkontakte bis zum Pressetext.

Deine Mission bei Foodji:

DAS BIETEN WIR DIR

  • Office Foodji: Immer bestens versorgt bei uns im Office

  • EGYM Wellpass: Mit uns bleibst du fit & wir bringen dich deutschlandweit in die angesagtesten Fitness- und Wellnessstudios

  • KITA/Kiga Kostenzuschuss: Wir bezuschussen deine Kosten für die Kinderbetreuung, damit deine Kinder immer bestens versorgt sind

  • Mitarbeiterrabatte: Du erhältst attraktive Promotions und Discounts verschiedener Brands

  • Food Tastings: Teste dich mit unserem Foodteam durch unsere Produkte und gestalte unser Sortiment von morgen

  • Development: Deine Weiterentwicklung liegt uns am Herzen und mit regelmäßigen Feedbackgesprächen und Trainings bieten wir dir spannende Perspektiven!

  • Top Office Lage: Genieße eine erstklassige Arbeitsumgebung im Münchener Glockenbachviertel mit der Isar vor der Tür

  • Team Events: Wir sind ein Team - beim Skiday, Frühstück, Culture Week oder Office Party feiern wir gemeinsam!

NOCH FRAGEN?

Silja freut sich auf deine Nachricht und hilft dir gerne weiter!

  • ÜBER UNS 

    Hi, schön, dass du da bist! Wir sind Foodji - ein Team aus Food-Lovern & Tech-Nerds.

    Unsere Mission ist es, frisches, gesundes und vor allem leckeres Essen überall dort anzubieten, wo Menschen den Großteil ihres Alltages verbringen - in Büros im Gewerbegebiet, wo es weit und breit nichts zu Essen gibt, in einer langen Schicht im Krankenhaus oder in den Tiefen einer Produktionshalle, in der rund um die Uhr Menschen arbeiten. Du findest uns auch in der Uni, am Flughafen und im Hotel und überall bieten wir vollwertige Gerichte, Snacks und Getränke genau dort an, wo und wann du sie brauchst.

    Proprietäre Technologien, selbstlernende Algorithmen und effiziente Lieferketten helfen uns, das Paradox zwischen frischem Essen, Verfügbarkeit und Nachhaltigkeit aufzulösen. Durch unsere eigens entwickelte Technologieplattform optimieren wir unsere Mengenplanung und sagen Food Waste den Kampf an. Wir wollen einen positiven Effekt haben - auf die Umwelt, auf den täglichen Alltag unserer Kunden und auf unsere Communities. Deshalb spenden wir Gerichte, die übrig bleiben, an Foodsharing und andere soziale Initiativen direkt vor unserer Haustür.

    Trage auch du deinen Teil dazu bei und bewirb dich jetzt.

title: Senior Technical SEO Manager (m/f/x)
description:
Atolls is the world's largest community-driven shopping platform, active in 20+ markets. 

We help millions make smarter spending decisions across discovery, evaluation, and (re-)purchase by connecting people with the right brands and retailers.

Our 1,000+ team across 10 countries builds products used every day at global scale, where you'll have real ownership and see your impact. Want to shape the destinations people rely on to shop with confidence? Keep reading.

About This Role:

We are looking for a Senior Technical SEO Manager to join our Marketing team in the Madrid Office. This position ensures the technical SEO integrity of our multilingual community commerce platform across nine international markets - like mydealz.de, hotukdeals, and more. It combines classic Technical SEO with solid AI, data, and automation skills to ensure that indexing, category, and reporting workflows are scalable and not manual.

Your contributions will help shape how millions of consumers interact with our platforms, guiding them to make smart, fair, and rewarding choices.

Our Benefits:

At Atolls, we believe in nurturing both your professional and personal growth. Here's what you can expect:

  • A culture that values personal and professional development, with internal mobility opportunities.
  • A supportive and open-minded team that embraces diverse perspectives and innovative ideas.
  • 32 days of paid vacation plus your birthday off, giving you the time you need to recharge.
  • A flexible hybrid working scheme to balance work and life.
  • Access to a learning budget and internal training to help you grow in your role.
  • Mental health coaching to support your well-being.
  • Regular global and local get-togethers to celebrate successes and build connections.
  • The possibility of taking a sabbatical after three years with the company.
  • A cloud-based company setup, providing flexibility and collaboration opportunities no matter where you are.

*These are global benefits that apply to all employees, with additional local perks based on your location.

Responsibilities:

In this role, you will:

  • Conduct technical audits, crawl/log-file analyses, and manage indexation (noindex, canonicals, robots.txt) to resolve issues on a platform with large URL volumes.
  • Strategically advance our Entity Optimization and Semantic Search capabilities through structured data (Schema.org) and internal linking to build a machine-readable Knowledge Graph.
  • Drive the technical readiness of the platform for generative search engines (GEO) and AI-powered answers (AIO), including managing AI crawlers.
  • Build and automate internal tools, apps, and monitoring workflows using an AI-first approach with tools like Claude, Lovable, v0, Cursor, and n8n.
  • Establish workflows to measure and analyze our visibility within AI answers and translate SEO goals into actionable technical requirements for Product & Tech teams.

 Your Profile:

We're looking for someone with deep experience in technical SEO for large-scale websites, who has a proven ability to leverage AI and automation to create scalable systems.

  • Proven experience working with Screaming Frog, GSC, Ahrefs/SISTRIX/SEMrush; HTML/CSS, JS rendering, Schema.org;
  • Deep understanding of entity-based search and Knowledge Graphs; AI-first building with LLMs (Claude, Lovable, etc.).
  • Nice to have: Dashboarding, database experience, programmatic SEO, and experience building agent/tooling infrastructures (n8n).
  • Experience isolating platform-wide patterns and algorithmic anomalies across all markets, distinguishing business impact from digital noise.
  • Systematically dissects root causes when algorithms change, finding creative workarounds where standard tools reach their limits.
  • Experience translating highly complex technical SEO dependencies into clear business value for Product Owners and developers.
  • Independently identifies and prioritizes high-impact actions and documents workflows to ensure team resilience.
  • Strong communication skills, both written and spoken in English; any other language is a plus

Our hiring process:

  1. TA Call: Meet one of our Talent Experts and get to know Atolls better.
  2. Technical Round: Focus on the technical aspects of the role (Through a Live Case), and meet your potential manager.
  3. Final Round: Meet other Atollians 🏝️
    It varies from 1 to 3 interviews

*Some processes might slightly change according to needs

Ready to apply?

Be part of a destination where your work helps millions of people make better decisions every day. One focused application is all we need. If you truly fit more than one role, you're welcome to apply to up to three. This helps us match you with the right opportunity faster.

We review every application with equal care and will reach out if your profile aligns. Apply now with your CV in English.
*Portfolios, writing samples, or certifications may be requested based on the role.

Leading investigations with a team of one or two, usually reporting to an engagement lead, the Senior Consultant will deliver high quality outcomes with senior support on the more complex elements. Delivery

  • Lead smaller investigations, compliance reviews and forensic accounting assignments in the UK and overseas, managing a team of one or two and usually reporting to an engagement lead.

  • Consistently meet the firm's standards for technical excellence, client service, delivery quality and commercial performance.
  • Recognise and escalate project risks and budget overruns in a timely manner, offering practical solutions and work arounds.
  • Begin to act as a trusted point of contact for clients on sensitive matters, providing clear, practical and well supported advice.

Leadership

  • Lead and motivate small engagement teams, setting clear direction and maintaining high standards.

Strategy and Market Development

  • Build and maintain relationships with clients through the consistent delivery of high-quality work.
  • Help identify client needs, regulatory developments and market trends that may create opportunities for the business.
  • Represent the firm at client meetings and industry events, supporting its visibility and reputation in the UK market.

Requirements

Knowledge and experience

  • Significant experience conducting internal investigations.
  • Experience of leading small teams and delivering high quality work with limited senior oversight.
  • A developing ability to coach and support more junior colleagues.
  • Experience of supporting business development and building client relationships.
  • Takes pride in displaying a high level of attention to detail and a structured, methodical approach to all tasks.

Qualifications and specialist skills

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent.
  • A chartered accountancy qualification (ACA, ACCA or equivalent) would be a significant advantage, ideally supported by further credentials such as the CFE.
  • Sound understanding of the use of technology in investigations.
  • A developing network of client contacts.

title: Managing Director, Data & AI - Pharma
description:
Founded in 2017, Unit8 is a fast-growing Swiss AI and data analytics consulting and services company dedicated to solving complex problems of traditional industries like automotive, chemical, financial services, manufacturing and pharma. We work with some of the biggest organisations in Europe to solve the challenges that directly affect their business - be it operations, finance, manufacturing or R&D. Since our foundation, we have successfully delivered more than 400 projects and have grown to 175+ talented individuals across 7 office locations.

Unit8’s mission is to drive the adoption of AI and Data Science in the non-digital industries and to help accelerate their digital transformation. Among its activities, Unit8 dedicates a part of its resources and time on projects that deeply matter to us - that includes collaboration on pro-bono and “engineering for good” causes. You can learn more about what we are passionate about at and on our you can find more useful information about our business and recruiting process.

Are You the Leader We're Looking For?

As Managing Director at Unit8, you won't just close deals — you'll be a cornerstone of how we grow and deliver Data & AI transformation for pharma clients across the DACH market. As we reorganize into verticals and horizontals, this role sits at the center of our pharma vertical: you own both sides of the equation — originating high-value client relationships and ensuring delivery actually moves the needle. If you've built your career at the intersection of commercial impact and technical credibility in life sciences, and you're ready to operate with real autonomy in an expert-led environment, this is the role.

What Success Looks Like in This Role

This is a senior leadership position for someone as comfortable originating a complex engagement as overseeing its delivery — with pharma as a main focus. You shape and close the deal, build relationships and trust with pharma decision-makers, and stay close enough to ensure technical execution delivers real value. You will succeed by:

  • Building and converting a pipeline of high-value opportunities in DACH pharma — through a network earned over years of credible data & AI work in the sector
  • Selling from expertise: pharma clients engage with you because you understand their regulatory, R&D, and commercial challenges firsthand — not because you have a polished pitch
  • Staying embedded in delivery long enough to set the right pace, challenge client assumptions, and keep teams focused on the actual business problem
  • Bridging the gap between data scientists/engineers and a pharma C-suite conversation — translating technical constraints into strategic decisions and vice versa
  • Raising the delivery bar by knowing what good looks like in pharma data & AI, and holding teams to that standard

What You'll Do

  • Leverage your existing pharma network to source, shape, and close high-value engagements in DACH (new logos, not just expansions)
  • Translate complex pharma business problems — from R&D data strategy to commercial analytics to regulatory-grade AI — into concrete Data & AI solutions, and hold clients accountable to realizing that value
  • Lead and shape complex, tech-enabled transformations across the pharma value chain — from early problem definition through scaled delivery — ensuring technology choices serve the business outcome, not the other way around
  • Act as the senior point of contact for key pharma clients throughout delivery, keeping technical execution anchored to business value
  • Challenge clients when necessary — on scope, pace, and ambition
  • Work closely with our engineering and data science teams (a horizontal you'll draw on across verticals), providing pharma business context, removing blockers, and coaching them

Requirements

Who You Are

You've run complex, tech-enabled transformations in pharma — from a top-tier global consultancy or a specialist data & AI firm. You've navigated high-stakes, ambiguous engagements through to delivery, with the results to show for it.

  • Significant experience in Data & AI consulting for pharma/life sciences, with a clear and verifiable track record of personally originating and closing major client relationships in the sector
  • Currently at Principal or Associate Partner / Director level — or equivalent — with the commercial track record and client ownership, looking for the next step
  • You don't need to write code, but you must "speak Tech" — understanding data architecture and AI well enough to raise our delivery bar and earn the respect of world-class engineers
  • An established network of senior client relationships in DACH pharma
  • Fluent in English. German and/or French (nice to have)
  • Comfortable traveling, including e.g. on-site engagements in the US (up to 5 weeks)

Benefits

What's In It For You

At Unit8, we don't just "turn data into value" — we empower the people who make it happen. If you are looking for a place where you can say, "I am independent and I take ownership", your next chapter starts here.

  • Trust from Day One: We believe in your expertise, and trust is a core part of our culture.
  • Work that Matters: You will do things that matter, and together we will facilitate the work of others.
  • Passion-Led Projects: We create an environment where you can pursue your passion alongside great talent. If the future makes you excited, you belong here.
  • Impact: You will be part of our leadership team and have a direct hand in shaping how Unit8 grows in the DACH market — defining our commercial approach, influencing which industries and clients we focus on, and setting the standard for how we deliver. This is not an execution role inside a fixed strategy; you help write it.
  • Competitive compensation package.
  • Flexibility & Growth: Above-the-norm flexibility on where and when you work, with up to 10% of your time dedicated to learning and pro-bono projects.
  • Connection & Fun: Whether it's our cross-office off-sites, online events, or a dedicated quarterly team budget for after-work activities, we make sure we stay connected.

We welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds and experiences, and are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive. If you meet the qualifications and are excited about the opportunity to contribute to our team, we encourage you to apply.

description:
JOIN US

Du schreibst gerne, hast ein gutes Gespür für Marken und kannst komplexes Wissen so aufbereiten, dass Menschen es wirklich verstehen? Dann könnte diese Rolle gut zu Dir passen.

Für unser Marketing-Team suchen wir eine:n Brand & Content Marketing Manager:in auf Mid-Level. Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit uns Content, der nach Code Gaia aussieht, nach Code Gaia klingt und Vertrauen in unsere Marke und Expertise aufbaut.

Viele unserer Inhalte sind einer der ersten Berührungspunkte mit Code Gaia. Deshalb ist uns wichtig, dass sie nicht nur fachlich richtig sind, sondern auch verständlich, nahbar und visuell konsistent umgesetzt werden.

WHAT YOU DO

  • Du entwickelst Content-Ideen aus aktuellen Marktsignalen und häufigen Fragen unserer Zielgruppen. In einem monatlichen Austausch mit unserem Sustainability Team greifst Du relevantes Expert:innenwissen auf und übersetzt es in verständlichen Content.
  • Du erstellst unter anderem Blogartikel, LinkedIn-Posts, Newsletter, Landingpages, Website-Texte und Sales-Enablement-Content.

  • Du wertest relevante Content- und Kampagnenkennzahlen aus und leitest gemeinsam mit dem Team Verbesserungen daraus ab.
  • Ergänzend planst und begleitest Du ausgewählte Webinare, Messen und Events – von der Kommunikation bis zur Nachbereitung.

WHO YOU ARE

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Content Marketing, Brand Marketing oder in einer vergleichbaren Rolle
  • Sehr gute schriftliche Ausdrucksfähigkeit und echte Freude am Schreiben
  • Ein gutes Gespür für Sprache, Storytelling, Tonalität und Markenwirkung
  • Die Fähigkeit, komplexe Themen schnell zu erfassen und verständlich aufzubereiten

  • Erste Erfahrung mit Webinaren, Messen oder anderen Events

WHAT TO EXPECT

So arbeitest Du bei uns

Die Rolle ist auf Mid-Level angesiedelt. Das bedeutet, dass Du Deine eigenen Themen und Projekte selbstständig steuerst und Verantwortung für eine zuverlässige Umsetzung übernimmst. Gleichzeitig bist Du Teil eines Teams, in dem wir gemeinsam an Content arbeiten, Ideen diskutieren und uns gegenseitig unterstützen.

Du musst nicht unsere gesamte Content-Strategie allein entwickeln oder jeden Inhalt von Anfang bis Ende selbst umsetzen. Übergreifende Prioritäten und strategische Entscheidungen treffen wir gemeinsam beziehungsweise in Abstimmung mit der Teamleitung.

About selectry
selectry is a Berlin-based HR-tech company building a skill-based alternative to traditional job-board recruiting. Instead of recycling generic job postings, we work directly with hiring companies to understand what a role really requires, then match candidates on demonstrated skills and mindset rather than job titles, degrees, or CV pedigree. Our process combines structured, AI-supported matching with a human review at every step, so no decision about a candidate is ever made by an algorithm alone. We are in active build phase: a small, cross-functional team that moves fast, owns problems end to end, and works fully remote across Germany. If you have worked in an early-stage or startup environment before, the pace and the level of ownership will feel familiar.

Your Role
You keep Sales and Operations running cleanly behind the scenes, so the team can focus on clients and candidates instead of chasing down data. This is an operational role built on concrete, recurring tasks: CRM administration, pipeline tracking, market research, and digital information management. A large part of it is detail-oriented upkeep, keeping records accurate, flagging gaps, and organising shared documents. If you prefer project work over structured maintenance, this is probably not the right fit. If you find satisfaction in clean systems and reliable data, you will feel at home. Because the team is small, your work is visible and your input reaches the people who act on it.

title: Senior Recruiter (f/m/d) Remote Germany
description:
The role in brief

You will join selectry as a Senior Recruiter and run end-to-end searches through our Hiring Engine for our clients. You own the process from structured intake to signed offer, use data to improve it, and build the sourcing infrastructure that makes the next search faster than the one before.

Why this role exists

selectry is a Berlin-based hr-tech company. We build and operate the Hiring Engine for plannable recruiting. Our three product lines cover different levels of recruiting ownership for our clients. What they share is a common requirement: searches need to be run well, documented clearly, and improved continuously.

We are a small, senior team. Decisions move quickly. The work is concrete. We run our own searches and source proactively rather than relying on inbound volume. We source, assess, and advise, and we document every step.

This role exists because the Hiring Engine needs an experienced recruiter who can carry searches independently, consult clients and hiring managers with evidence and clarity, and help build the sourcing and process infrastructure that makes selectry's output reliable and repeatable.

What you will work on

  • Own the full recruiting lifecycle across client searches, from intake and role clarification through active sourcing, structured assessment, and offer management to signed contract

  • Design and run multi-channel sourcing strategies using LinkedIn Recruiter, XING, and direct outreach, including complex Boolean search and talent mapping for specialist and leadership profiles

  • Build and maintain talent pools of passive candidates across the segments selectry searches most frequently, structured, auditable, and ready for the next search

  • Conduct structured, competency-based interviews and advise hiring managers on evaluation criteria, profile fit, and decision quality

  • Track, analyse, and report on recruiting KPIs, including time-to-hire, time-to-fill, funnel conversion, and source-of-hire, and use the data to improve the process at every stage

  • Create and maintain search briefs, outreach templates, and interview guides within selectry's documentation infrastructure

  • Lead employer branding projects for selectry itself, for example career page content, candidate experience improvements, and outreach standards


Must-haves

  • Strong experience in recruiting, with end-to-end ownership of complex, specialist, or leadership hiring processes from sourcing through to offer

  • Hands-on active sourcing experience with LinkedIn Recruiter and multi-channel direct outreach, including the ability to design Boolean search strategies and talent maps independently

  • Experience building and maintaining structured talent pools for passive candidate segments using a CRM or ATS

  • Experience conducting competency-based candidate interviews and advising hiring managers on evaluation frameworks and profile decisions

  • KPI literacy: you have tracked recruiting data and used it to change a process, with a concrete example you can explain

  • German at C2 level and English at minimum C1, both required from day one, as searches run in both languages

  • Reliable self-management in a remote setup, careful documentation, and clear written communication

Nice-to-haves

  • Background in sales recruiting, executive search, or specialist/leadership hiring in a B2B or technology environment

  • Delivered employer branding work with concrete outputs, for example employer value proposition (EVP) development, career page content, candidate experience design, or career fair coordination

  • Familiarity with mid-market ATS or CRM-based recruiting platforms, for example Personio, Greenhouse, or Recruitee

  • Familiarity with the DACH talent market and its sourcing dynamics, particularly for niche or hard-to-fill profiles

How we work

selectry is fully remote within Germany, with our registered office in Berlin. The team is deliberately small so decisions are made quickly and work stays concrete. We use documented playbooks, clean process logic, and a tooling setup.

Technology supports the work. Humans verify and decide. That applies to how we run our product and to how we work internally.

There are no vanity metrics here. A good search is one where the right person was found, the process was fair, and the documentation lets us learn from it.

Working conditions

Location: 100% remote (DE), registered office in Berlin

Work model: Full-time, flexible hours with agreed collaboration windows

Contract: Permanent employment

Languages: German C2 (mandatory), English min. C1 (mandatory)

Salary: Discussed transparently in the first conversation

Start: As soon as possible

Holiday: 30 days plus public holidays in your federal state

How to apply

Apply with your CV. No formal cover letter required.

If you have relevant work samples, for example Boolean search strings, sourcing strategies, anonymised KPI dashboards, or process documentation, feel free to include them. They are welcome but not mandatory.

Our hiring process:

  1. 30-minute introduction call

  2. Skills interview in German, including a short live sourcing exercise

  3. Practical take-home personality test focused on your thinking logic and approach

  4. Final conversation with peers and Management, followed by offer discussion

We give clear, timely feedback at every stage.

Before you apply

If you match most of the profile but not every point, we would still welcome a conversation. The requirements above describe what matters for the role, not a checklist for perfection.

Equal opportunity and data protection

selectry GmbH is committed to equal opportunity. We hire for skill and potential. Applications are welcome regardless of gender, age, origin, religion, sexual orientation, disability, or family status. Accessible process steps are available on request.

Your application data is processed exclusively for the purpose of this recruitment process in accordance with the GDPR. If you would like your data corrected or deleted, contact .

title: Software Development Engineer - macOS Endpoint
Account Director (Freelance)
Account Director (Freelance)
Senior Product Design Engineer
Senior Director, Social Commerce
Platform Engineer
description:
Hi, we’re Bloom & Wild. Founded in 2013, our mission back then was to make sending and receiving flowers the joy that it should be, by harnessing technology, brand and letterbox delivery. Together, we’ve fulfilled over 20 million deliveries (and counting!), making us the largest direct to consumer flower business in Europe.

We announced £75 million Series D funding in 2021 and that same year acquired bloomon in The Netherlands and Bergamotte in France. Now home to a family of 3 beautiful brands, we're expanding our gifting offering to other categories like cakes, candles and cocktails. This is all part of our ambition to build Europe's #1 direct to consumer gifting destination. 

⚙️Technology at Bloom & Wild

Our Technology team of over 60 people sits right at the heart of our business. We build and maintain the solutions that power e-commerce, production and fulfilment, enabling our brands to delight our customers every day.

The Product Engineering team consists of five cross-functional squads who each lead their own business and architectural domain, and are supported by our Platform, Domain Engineering, Data and IT teams.

Our platform uses technologies including Ruby and Rails and Python/ React, backed by PostgreSQL, Fargate/ECS on AWS, and Cloud Run on GCP. It exposes APIs that are used by our multi-brand Angular webapp and our native iOS and Android mobile apps.  We’re also looking at developing new domain driven services & microservices where applicable.

Most of our team is based in the UK or The Netherlands and works in a flexible model, with choice in how often they travel to the office. Our squads meet in person at least once per quarter in order to maintain connections, collaborate on larger projects and have fun together.

You can read lots more about our technology stack and our culture over on our tech blog - Code & Wild


💻 What you’ll be doing

As a Platform Engineer you'll work across the whole of Technology (Frontend, Backend, Data Engineering, Data Science and Warehouse Tech) helping other engineers ship better, faster, and more safely. You'll split your time roughly equally between embedded engagements inside domain squads and central platform work on the shared infrastructure.

The role of an engineer is changing. AI has removed writing code as the scarce skill; the valuable engineer is the one who picks the right problems, scopes them, and owns them through to how they behave in production. This role leans into that shift. You will work with a high degree of independence and the work isn't always handed to you as ready-made tickets, so you'll have space to identify, shape and deliver on solutions end-to-end.

This includes:

  • Embedded Engagements: Partner with domain squads, shipping code and tools to directly enhance their capability and solve real problems.

  • Paved Roads: Build shared, adoption-driven infrastructure like feature flags, canary rollouts, fast builds, and CI/CD patterns. Making the easiest path the best path.

  • AI Integration: Extend AI across the engineering lifecycle (ticket generation, config authoring, incident response, code review), operating with AI as your core working mode and creating reusable patterns.

  • Core Infrastructure: Maintain and evolve shared services: AWS, GitHub, Datadog, Cloudflare, distributing ownership across the Platform team.

  • Eliminate Toil: Automate manual processes and remove friction from the developer day-to-day.

  • Enable Ownership: Coach squads on SLOs, observability, and AI tooling, ensuring they are capable of leading their production behaviour without relying on Platform.

  • Strategic Impact: Proactively identify, scope, and deliver high-leverage problems from month six onwards.


    • ✅ You’ll love this role if you…
  • Have day-to-day experience with AWS and Terraform, and the judgement to balance performance, cost, and reliability.
  • Our stack includes ECS Fargate, RDS, ElastiCache, DynamoDB, Lambda, and EventBridge.
  • Have good judgement across CI/CD and observability, comfortable with safe and reliable deployment practices (we use GitHub Actions and Terraform Cloud), and comfortable using metrics, logs, and traces to understand how applications and infrastructure behave.
  • Experience and enthusiasm using AI coding tools, or a keenness to adopt this style of working.
  • Are willing to pick up app-side stacks like Ruby and Python, and are comfortable operating inside long-lived monoliths without trying to rewrite them.
  • Take end-to-end ownership of problems (even without a ticket) you're comfortable operating in ambiguity and defining the problem before the solution.
  • A curious and innovative mindset, open to feedback and coaching, and seek out opportunities for learning and development.
  • Driven to deliver high-quality results and take initiative.
  • You love to collaborate, and are at your best when working cross-functionally with other teams.
  • You're excited about problem-solving and love to take a logical and collaborative approach to finding solutions.

    •  

    It would be great if you also have...

  • Been part of rolling out production-ownership practices across a team or organisation.

  • Experience working on an e-commerce site or in a fast-growing (preferably consumer-facing) environment.

  • Experience setting patterns that other engineers adopted without being told to.

  • Experience writing services or apps that fit into distributed architectures — working with APIs, event-driven patterns, and the contracts and practices that keep distributed systems stable.

title: Staff Site Reliability Engineer
description:
Who We Are

AI is changing how software gets built. Code production is becoming a commodity. The focus is shifting from writing code to orchestrating, verifying, and governing change – and the toolchain is the new constraint.

We are at the center of this shift. We build Develocity, a toolchain observability and intelligence platform used by some of the world's leading software organizations – Netflix, Airbnb, Spotify, SAP, major global banks, and hundreds more. Develocity helps software teams achieve delivery excellence through deep observability, build and test acceleration, and AI-powered intelligence across the entire toolchain – with current support for Gradle Build Tool, Apache Maven™, sbt, npm, and Python.

We are an AI-native company. AI is not a feature we're bolting on – it's central to how we work, how we think about our product, and where we're heading. We're investing deeply in making Develocity's unique data and decades of domain expertise accessible to both humans and AI agents, with trust, evidence, and explainability at the core of everything we build.

We have partnered with the Apache Software Foundation, the Commonhaus Foundation, the Micronaut Foundation, and other OSS projects such as Spring, Quarkus, Kotlin, JUnit, AndroidX, and many more to bring the values of Develocity also to the OSS Community.

Our Values

Seek to Understand: Everything starts with listening and understanding; we strive to understand diverse viewpoints, problems, and motivations. Before we take action, we ensure we truly grasp the challenges, perspectives, and goals. 

Know the Why: We approach our work with a clear sense of purpose, ensuring every step is deliberate and focused. We take meaningful action with urgency, but never at the expense of thoughtful consideration. 

Innovate & Iterate: We embrace challenges and are not afraid to try new things, even if they might fail. With a deep understanding and a clear purpose, we can develop creative, bold solutions to tackle challenges.

Own the Outcome: We are empowered to take initiative, and we maintain transparency in our work and its outcomes. When we execute, we take responsibility for our decisions, measure the success of our innovations, and learn from the results.

Who You Are

We're building a new SRE team and looking for founding members to help shape how we operate. As a Lead SRE, you'll be a technical and operational leader for reliability across Develocity. You'll help define our SRE vision, set standards for how we operate production services, and mentor other SREs as the team grows. This is a hands-on role with broad influence across engineering, cloud platform, and customer-facing teams.

The SRE team will be responsible for the reliability, performance, and availability of Develocity instances serving paying customers, open-source projects, and public-facing services, plus supporting infrastructure like artifact registries.

You'll work on our internally-built Cloud Application Platform, Kubernetes on AWS, and develop deep expertise in it. When incidents happen, you'll troubleshoot issues across the stack, from application to infrastructure. You'll collaborate with the Cloud Platform team to improve the tooling you depend on, and with engineering teams to build reliability into how we ship software. If you like automating things and hate doing the same task twice, you'll fit in well.

You'll be part of a distributed, remote-first team that values asynchronous communication and written documentation. Strong self-direction and clear communication across time zones are essential.

Responsibilities

  • Operate and maintain all Develocity instances and supporting services in production.
  • Define and evolve SRE standards, practices, and operating models, including on-call, incident response, postmortems, and SLOs.
  • Participate in a follow-the-sun on-call rotation, acting as a technical escalation point for complex or high-severity incidents.
  • Lead incident response and blameless retrospectives, ensuring learnings result in measurable reliability improvements.
  • Set reliability priorities using risk, customer impact, business goals, SLOs, and error budgets.
  • Identify systemic reliability risks and continuously evolve Develocity's SaaS operations as the platform and customer base grow.
  • Lead and influence architectural and design reviews to ensure reliability, scalability, and operability.
  • Drive automation across deployment, upgrades, monitoring, self-healing, recovery, and operational workflows.
  • Build and maintain comprehensive observability for all managed services, including logging, metrics, tracing, and alerting.
  • Own disaster recovery, backups, and business continuity planning and execution.
  • Partner with engineering leadership to balance feature delivery with reliability and operational excellence.
  • Mentor and coach SREs, supporting technical growth and strong operational practices.
  • Help onboard new SREs and contribute to hiring by defining and assessing SRE excellence at Develocity.
  • Communicate clearly with customers during incidents and maintenance windows.
  • Optimize performance, resource utilization, and operational costs.

Minimum qualifications

  • 7+ years in SRE, DevOps, or an equivalent role operating production services at scale.
  • Experience leading reliability initiatives across multiple teams or services.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence technical direction without direct authority.
  • Experience designing and operating systems with SLOs and error budgets, and exercising strong judgment in balancing reliability, velocity, and cost.
  • Strong Kubernetes experience in production environments.
  • Cloud infrastructure expertise, preferably AWS (EKS, RDS, S3, EC2).
  • Proficiency with observability tools (Prometheus, Grafana) and Infrastructure as Code (Terraform).
  • Track record of incident management and response in a 24/7 on-call environment.
  • Scripting proficiency (Python, Bash) for automation.
  • Strong written and verbal English communication skills.

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience as a founding or early SRE establishing practices in a growing SaaS organization.
  • Familiarity with Develocity.
  • JVM language experience (Java, Kotlin).
  • Experience with customer-facing and executive-level incident communications.

What We Offer

  • A ground-floor role in a new SRE team - you'll shape how we do things, not inherit someone else's decisions.
  • Real ownership of production systems used by engineers at companies you've heard of.
  • Direct interaction with customers when things go wrong (and when they go right).
  • A culture that values automation over heroics.
  • In-person meetings, such as our annual company offsite and team meetings.
  • Work from home in a remote-first environment.
  • Competitive salaries and equity grants.

Location

  • Remote from anywhere in Europe (GMT). 
  • While our team works remotely and is spread across the globe, we deeply value daily interactions and collaboration.

title: Staff Applied AI Engineer

description:
About SugarAI UK Limited

SugarAI is redefining CRM for the age of AI.

We’re delivering on the original promise of CRM—turning fragmented customer and revenue signals into clear, prioritized action. Instead of more dashboards or surface-level insights, we help teams focus on what matters most and know exactly what to do next.

More than two decades after our founding, we’re entering a new chapter with clarity and momentum—building intelligent, intuitive solutions that work within the flow of how teams actually sell and serve. We’re focused on solving complex, real-world challenges where relationships, context, and precision make all the difference.

Our global team is united by a shared commitment to impact, ownership, and continuous growth. We create an environment where thoughtful ideas move quickly, where people are trusted to lead, and where flexibility supports how great work gets done.

If you’re excited to help shape what’s next in AI-driven CRM—and build technology that drives real outcomes—we’d love to meet you.

Where You Fit In: 
SugarAI ships AI-powered selling and sales intelligence products in a market that moves faster every day. We are focused on quality, functionality, and speed to delivery, and the engineers who thrive here don't treat AI tools as a productivity add-on they've fundamentally changed how they work, using agentic development workflows to go from specification to production-ready code faster than they could before, without sacrificing correctness or quality. 

This is not a role for someone who favors traditional software development, or is curious about AI-assisted development and plans to explore it. It's a role for someone who already works this way who writes clear, machine-readable specifications that feed the agentic development system, uses agentic development tools as standard equipment, and applies genuine critical judgment to what these tools produce before it ships. You'll build systems and features that power real customer outcomes in a B2B SaaS platform at scale, and you'll do it inside a delivery model where human judgment is the differentiating input, not the bottleneck. 

If you want to work on meaningful software with teammates who hold the bar high on both speed and craft, this role is for you.

This role operates on a hybrid model, with a mix of remote work and in-office collaboration at our Solihull location, specifically, working in-office a minimum of 2 days per week.

 

Disclaimer: When applying to this job posting, you are submitting your application for consideration of a role which may or may not actually exist, or be available now or in the future. Application submission is agreeing to be added to our Applicant Tracking System database, so we have the potential to surface your profile and reach out to you in the future, for opportunities which appear to be aligned to your background, experience or network.
 
To be considered for a specific job opening, please check out our Careers Page and apply to an active job posting. 

Impact You Will Make in the Role (Key Responsibilities): 

Agentic Development Systems 

  • Work from executable specifications — write clear SDD/BDD specs and acceptance criteria as the primary input for AI-assisted code generation, and keep them current as implementation evolves 

  • Use agentic coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, or equivalents) as standard equipment across the full SDLC, from spec to implementation to test generation to code review 

  • Apply critical judgment to AI-generated code and agentic attestations before merge — assess correctness, edge cases, security implications, and alignment with the spec; your review is a real gate, not a formality 

  • Contribute to the team's agentic development practices: spec standards, attestation norms, and how the team uses AI tools responsibly 

Feature Delivery 

  • Design, implement, and ship features and components that are reliable, maintainable, and built to perform in high volume, high-availability SaaS environments 

  • Ensure agentic code is clean, well tested, and follows the standards that make it easy to understand and extend by both agentic systems and your teammates 

  • Own your feature areas end-to-end, from understanding the requirement to production delivery, including identifying and resolving defects before they reach customers 

Code Quality & Review 

  • Review outputs, including AI-generated code and agentic attestations, with the care and rigor the team depends on; catch what automation misses 

  • Orchestrate unit and integration test development that verifies real behaviour, not just execution paths; apply the same critical eye to test quality as to production code 

  • Contribute to the team's technical standards and raise the bar on engineering operations excellence across all facets of our AI SDLC 

Collaboration & Systems Thinking 

  • Work closely with product managers, designers, and QA engineers to understand requirements and build the right thing, not just the specified thing 

  • Think beyond your immediate feature: understand the systems your code interacts with, the data it produces, and the downstream effects of your design decisions 

  • Communicate clearly in writing in specs, in code reviews, in async updatesto keep cross-functional and globally distributed teams aligned 

  • Participate in agile and team ceremonies, including Sprint Review, Program Reviews, and other technical presentations 


What You Will Bring (Qualifications/Experience): 

  • 2–5 years of experience developing enterprise or SaaS software in production environments 

  • Personal fluency with agentic coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, or equivalents) you use these in your daily work and real delivery scenarios, not as an experiment 

  • Hands-on experience with BDD/SDD frameworks and working from executable specifications as the primary input to development, this is how we work, not a practice you're learning on the job 

  • Proficiency in at least one object-oriented or modern SaaS language; comfort picking up new languages and frameworks as the work demands 

  • Experience with RESTful API design and consumption 

  • Working knowledge of SQL and NoSQL data stores 

  • Experience producing and maintaining automated test suites (unit, integration, or end-to-end) 

  • Experience working in Agile delivery environments with CI/CD pipelines 

  • Strong written communication skills; able to write clear specs, meaningful code review feedback, and async updates for a global team 


Preferred Qualifications/Experience: 

  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS or equivalent) and microservices architectures 

  • Familiarity with containerization, infrastructure-as-code, or observability tooling 

  • Experience developing or integrating with AI/ML features in a production SaaS product 

  • Background in B2B SaaS, CRM, or revenue technology 

We understand that no candidate is perfectly qualified for any job. Experience comes in different forms; many skills are transferable; and passion goes a long way. Even more important than your resume is a clear demonstration of dedication, impact, and the ability to thrive in a fluid and collaborative environment. We want you to learn new things in this role, and we encourage you to apply if your experience is close to what we’re looking for. We also know that diversity of background and thought makes for better problem solving and more creative thinking, which is why we're dedicated to adding new perspectives to the team.
 
Benefits and Perks:
Beyond a stellar work environment, friendly people, and inspiring work, we have some sweet benefits and perks:
 
·       UK Pension Scheme
·       Private medical and dental insurance
·       Health &Wellness Reimbursement Program

·       Educational Resources - Career & Personal Development Program
·       Various discount programs (i.e. travel, virtual exercises classes, etc.)
·       We are a merit-based company with many opportunities to learn, excel and grow your career!

title: Principal Counsel, Africa Legal
description:
About Zipline

Zipline is the world's largest and most experienced drone delivery service. We are on a mission to serve all humans equally by ensuring access to food, medicine and essential goods anytime, anywhere. We design, build, and operate the world's largest autonomous logistics system, delivering critical supplies quickly and reliably. Today, Zipline operates on four continents, makes a delivery somewhere in the world every 30 seconds, and has completed millions of deliveries to date, including blood, vaccines, medical supplies, food, and retail products. 

Our customers include the world's largest and most prominent healthcare systems, governments, retailers, restaurants and global businesses who rely on us to save lives, reduce emissions, increase economic opportunity, and provide delivery from point A to point B as fast as possible. The drone is only 15% of what we've built to enable seamless, reliable, global operations.

Our system strengthens supply chains, reduces congestion, and gives people time back. With more than 140 million commercial autonomous miles safely flown, Zipline is redefining access to healthcare, consumer products, and food across the globe.

We operate at a global scale and are looking for practical problem solvers who thrive on real-world challenges and rapid growth. Our team is motivated by building systems that have a direct, meaningful impact on people's lives and by scaling the future of logistics. We are seeking people who sculpt from first principles, enjoy facing adversity, and can do the impossible at record breaking speeds.

About You and The Role

Zipline is seeking a senior, strategic, and highly adaptable lawyer to lead and scale legal and compliance across multiple countries of operation in Africa. This role sits at the intersection of compliance execution and regulatory strategy and is critical to enabling Zipline's continued growth in complex and evolving regulatory environments.

You will independently lead all Africa Legal & Compliance operations and strategy while serving as an integral member of Zipline International's high-impact Legal Team. You will also be a key member of the Zipline Africa Leadership Team, with the Heads of People and Finance and our Country Directors, and with a dotted reporting line to Zipline Africa's CEO. You will work cross-functionally with the Africa Leadership Team, Operations, Policy, Government Affairs, People, Finance, and Engineering, and will report directly to Zipline's Deputy General Counsel.

This is a hands-on leadership role that offers the rare opportunity to build and shape the Legal function with significant autonomy, while benefiting from the collaboration and support of a larger global legal team. One day you may be advising on a complex Nigerian employment or a healthcare regulatory issue in Cote d'Ivoire; the next, developing compliance training for teams across Africa or helping the business navigate export controls, sanctions, anti-corruption, and other cross-border legal risks.

What You'll Do

  • Design, implement, scale, and continuously improve Zipline's legal and compliance programs across Africa, with a focus on sustainable, practical operations that support rapid growth
  • Lead day-to-day compliance workstreams covering sanctions, anti-bribery and anti-corruption, privacy, healthcare, employment, and product-related regulations
  • Support internal investigations, audits, and risk assessments, partnering closely with People, Finance, and senior leadership
  • Manage litigation and disputes across Zipline's African markets 
  • Translate complex regulatory requirements into clear, actionable guidance for business and technical teams
  • Own compliance with U.S. government award requirements, including FARs and 2 CFR 200, and serve as a primary point of contact for U.S. government contracting officers (including at the U.S. Department of State)
  • Monitor and assess regulatory and policy developments across relevant African jurisdictions and advise leadership on emerging risks and opportunities

Cross-Functional Partnership & Culture

  • Act as a senior legal advisor to business leaders, providing pragmatic, risk-calibrated guidance 
  • Build strong relationships across the company and help foster a durable "culture of compliance" where teams understand the rules of the road and feel empowered to raise issues early
  • Help shape Zipline's long-term legal and regulatory strategy in Africa, balancing compliance rigor with innovation and speed

What You'll Bring

  • A willingness to dive deep into unfamiliar issues and operate effectively in ambiguous, fast-environments
  • Strong judgment and the confidence to make independent decisions, coupled with the discernment to escalate when appropriate
  • Experience advising on legal and compliance matters, preferably in international or emerging-market environments
  • The ability to break down complex legal and regulatory problems into clear priorities and practical solutions
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, including the ability to advise senior stakeholders
  • A collaborative, solutions-oriented mindset and strong organizational skills
  • Willingness to travel up to ~25% to Africa and San Francisco headquarters

We are seeking a Senior Data Engineer to join our Data Team, taking a leading role in building the complex, scalable systems that power our data strategy.   • Work closely with data engineers, business analysts and IT teams to define data requirements and deliver comprehensive data solutions. Provide technical leadership and guidance to team members.
  • Evaluate new GCP features and data-engineering technologies, setting technical direction where they can enhance data infrastructure or enable new data products.
  • Lead the resolution of critical pipeline failures and data-quality incidents, performing fault analysis and ensuring that preventative improvements are implemented.
  • Lead critical system-design and architectural decisions for scalable batch and real-time workloads.
  • Partner with cross-functional teams to translate complex or ambiguous business needs into effective and innovative data solutions.
  • Mentor engineers, review technical designs and foster a culture of continuous learning and engineering excellence.
  • Own improvements to the reliability, performance and cost-effectiveness of data systems.
  • Lead the design and maintenance of robust, secure integrations with core internal systems and critical third-party platforms.
  • Define appropriate monitoring and alerting standards to ensure high system reliability and minimal downtime.

Skills, Knowledge and Experience 

  • Significant experience in data engineering or data warehousing with large-scale, complex datasets.
  • Advanced SQL and Python skills, with experience using AI-assisted development tools appropriately.
  • Strong knowledge of data-modelling techniques.
  • Deep experience with cloud data services and technologies, ideally within the GCP ecosystem, such as Dataflow, Pub/Sub, BigQuery or Vertex AI.
  • Proven experience designing and implementing robust ELT pipelines, including real-time and large-scale batch processing.
  • Proven ability to deploy and maintain data infrastructure using Infrastructure as Code principles and tools such as Terraform.
  • Experience with Airflow environment management and Docker.
  • Experience contributing to an AI roadmap and evaluating AI tooling, including coding agents, for use within the development lifecycle.
  • The ability to explain complex technical concepts clearly and concisely to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Demonstrable experience applying data-governance, privacy and security best practices in a regulated environment.
  • A proactive and curious approach, with the ability to anticipate and resolve system inefficiencies.
  • The ability to lead cross-functional technical work and translate complex or ambiguous requirements into robust data solutions.
  • A track record of taking end-to-end ownership for the quality, reliability and performance of business-critical data solutions.
  • Experience mentoring engineers and influencing technical standards across a team.

What can we offer?

  • Flexible Working Agreements where applicable
  • Private Healthcare Scheme + Employee Enhanced Assistance
  • Enhanced Family Leave - Maternity, Shared Parental & Adoption Leave: up to 6 months at full pay and 6 months at half pay. Paternity leave: up to 4 weeks at full pay
  • Subsidised Gym Membership
  • Annual Travel Card Loan & Ride to Work Scheme
  • Life Assurance (x3 salary)
